name: ImageLightbox
description: A full-screen image viewer opened from a thumbnail with a hero-like scale+fade transition. Pinch or scroll to zoom, drag to pan, double-tap to toggle zoom, swipe between images, and close on Escape, the backdrop or the × button. Captions, a counter and a thumbnail strip are optional chrome. Images render through the image component's Picture.

fields.barrierColor: ThemedColor? - scrim behind the image; null = 60% black
fields.surfaceColor: ThemedColor? - caption/thumbnail chrome fill; null = background token (frosted)
fields.foreground: ThemedColor? - counter and caption text; null = foreground token
fields.closeButtonColor: ThemedColor? - close glyph; null = foreground token
fields.closeButtonBackground: ThemedColor? - close button fill; null = background token

accessibility.keyboard: Escape closes; ArrowLeft/Right move between images; the close button is a labelled button
accessibility.semantics: images announce their semanticLabel; the counter reads 'n / total'; the close button is labelled 'Close'

notes: Images render through the image component's Picture, so loading and error slots behave exactly like everywhere else in the kit.
The open transition is a hero-like scale+fade route transition timed by the theme motion tokens; under reduced motion the route snaps.
Zoom uses InteractiveViewer with a TransformationController; pan enables only above 1.01x so PageView swipes work at 1x.
Double-tap toggles between 1x and the doubleTapScale, animated with a Matrix4Tween; the zoom-around-point matrix is built with setEntry to avoid the deprecated translate/scale helpers.
The caption/thumbnail chrome is a frosted surface through the shared surface primitive (surfaceColor + GlassSurface), so the ambient surfaceOpacity/surfaceBlur apply.
Single tap on the image closes (Flutter disambiguates it from the double-tap zoom); the backdrop, Escape and the × button also close.
